TELGetDNInfo

Updates the information in a directory number structure. 
pascal TELErr TELGetDNInfo (TELDNHandle hTELDN);
hTELDN
A handle to a directory number structure.
function result
A result code.
DESCRIPTION
The TELGetDNInfo function updates the directory number structure specified by the hTELDN parameter. You should pass in a handle to an existing directory number structure. If TELGetDNInfo completes successfully, the fields of that structure reflect the current state and capabilities of the associated directory number.
